versioning_note: 0.2.0, 0.3.0, and 0.3.1 were development-branch identifiers and were not tagged public releases. v0.4.0 is the public pre-1.0 preview on main. v0.5.0 is the visual-storytelling branch built on that preview; it is not a tag, does not advance main, and changes no runtime behavior. v1.0.0 remains deferred.
changes: Read-only WSL2 diagnostic CLI with environment diagnosis, RAW-bracketed probes, offline analysis, finite kernel-state observation, comparison, and Python environment checks.
RAW-origin acquisition scheduling with finite guard behavior and fail-closed schema-v2 completion verification.
Uncertainty-aware fixed-window rate analysis, adjacent signed REALTIME events, cumulative fixed-window REALTIME-minus-RAW evidence, and legacy v0.1 input support.
Read-only adjtimex(modes=0) observation with explicit Linux x86-64 LP64 ABI validation and structured unsupported/error states.
Method-aware comparison that preserves anomaly classifications and refuses numeric differences for incompatible or insufficient context.
Primary-source Microsoft/Canonical time-sync research with fresh-install versus upgrade caveats and no unsupported 24.04 backport claim.
Evidence-tiered README, D4R2 animated viewer, WSL host/kernel/guest architecture diagram, and dated upstream timeline.
Release-neutral documentation naming, preview security/support policy, and repository/package branding cleanup.

presentation_assets.three-model-timing-comparison.svg: README hero. Three panels share one 0-120 s axis and one symmetric-log ppm scale with the +/-1000 ppm screen; cursors move together at ten times real time. Left panel (24.04, timesyncd enabled): documented two-writer default drawn as an architecture-risk band with no measured trace, plus the C1 A0 observation of four REALTIME steps of about +0.59 to +0.63 s (events, not a rate series); its only summary is qualitative. Middle panel (24.04 after the stop, D4R2, Windows QPC reference): t = 0 is the window opening about 60 s after the confirmed stop with the unit still enabled; the four published 30 s enclosures appear as each window closes, the 120 s enclosure +6,661.607 to +6,676.217 ppm appears at 120 s, PRE tick 10833 and POST tick 10000 are marked, and the 0-60 s and 0-90 s running means are labelled as derived from the published windows assuming equal 30 s windows. Right panel (26.04 fresh default, guest reference): one-writer documented default; each 30 s window is marked inside the screen without a per-window value because none is published; the 300 s full-run enclosure -0.504500 to -0.463656 ppm and worst window bound -1.191303 ppm appear at the final checkpoint and are labelled 300 s and guest-side. Cursors and sampling washes are illustrative and hidden when animation is off; the static/reduced-motion state is the complete result.
presentation_assets.clock-steering-story.svg: Shown in the 'What is actually unique here?' section. Card A (24.04 default) and card D (26.04 fresh default) show documented control paths only, with no fabricated rate trace; card A carries the C1 A0 REALTIME-step observation and card D the 300 s guest-side screen (full run -0.504500 to -0.463656 ppm, worst window bound -1.191303 ppm, ten windows inside the +/-1000 ppm screen) on a +/-2 ppm track labelled guest-side. Card B (24.04 after systemctl stop) shows the measured D4R2 state: timesyncd stopped with the unit still enabled, PRE tick 10833 about 60 s after the stop and POST tick 10000 later, each marked 'set by ?' / 'reset by ?'. The chart replays the four published 30 s MONOTONIC/QPC enclosures, the 120 s average and the RAW/QPC full-run enclosure at ten times real time on a symmetric-log axis; the only derived figure (about +0.80 s over window 1) is labelled derived; the cursor and sampling wash are illustrative and hidden when animation is off; the static/reduced-motion state is the complete result.
presentation_assets.d4r2-settling-animated.svg: Step-by-step D4R2 replay, now embedded beside the full table in docs/timesyncd-investigation.md. Published D4R2 interval enclosures only; playback starts at the confirmed service-stop transition, shows the stopped timesyncd path while kernel tick/freq state persists, labels derived/inferred/not-established content, and has a coherent static/reduced-motion result.
presentation_assets.architecture-host-vm-guest.svg: Microsoft/Canonical default architecture is separated from project measurement points and bounded interpretation.
presentation_assets.upstream-timeline.svg: Vendor and project events are separate lanes; WSL 2.1.1 is identified as a prerelease and later Microsoft reports are not equated with #10006.
